name: phone-bud
description: Place real phone calls to US and Canada numbers, one number or a short list of businesses, and get back the summary and transcript.

interface.shortDescription: Place real phone calls to US and Canada numbers and get back the transcript
interface.longDescription:
Phone Bud places real outbound phone calls with an AI voice agent. Ask Codex to call a business or person, check stock, a price, hours or availability, book or move an appointment, or ask a short list of places the same question. Each call returns a summary, the outcome, key details and the transcript.

The agent gets through phone menus, waits on hold, says it's an AI if asked, and never claims to be a person. The skill has Codex confirm the number and the request with you before every call. Calls use your Phone Bud minutes; the first call is free, up to 5 minutes.
